This neuron sits on function words and punctuation (quotes, spaces, periods, "a", "is", "every") in generic filler/boilerplate contexts, and is most strongly *suppressed* on the same kind of connective words ("is", "of", "include") when they immediately introduce a specific named entity or technical term (e.g. "is Blackheads", "include blepharoplasty", "of Health") — i.e. it appears to track whether the upcoming word is generic vs. a specific label.
